newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia needs "exit policies" for ailing industry - IMF.
newsitem.headline: Asia needs "exit policies" for ailing industry - IMF.

text.p: Asian countries need to develop policies to ease the shift out of non-competitive industries as the economic base changes, Michel Camdessus, managing director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), said on Friday.

"As production shifts to higher-value products, (Asian) countries will need to develop effective exit policies for non-competitive industries," Camdessus told an IMF-Hong Kong Monetary Authority conference.
These changes would "inevitably require other adjustment as well", he said.

Countries which had already benefited from trade liberalisation "must ensure that the openness that has served them so well in the past is extended to the new frontiers, notably services", Camdessus said.
